And then again, in early February on our rebound that we saw. So this is our big, largest point of resistance that we have to break through if we do want to see a bigger extension for Ada and other assets around the crypto space. So we're just going to have to watch this very closely as the day progresses. USDT dominance, again, making another move down. The IRGC responds to President Trump saying, we are the ones who will determine the end of the war. It's also come out that an Iranian official says they are not seeking a ceasefire anymore. So, again, there could be further potential escalations and you can see oil start surging again. I will say gold and silver are both up this morning, Not surprising with that statement. So again we'll just have to be patient, and wait and see what happens. Appreciate you guys have a great day. Show your love below. Catch you guys in the next one. Take care
